description: FinSight AI Step 9 -- Investment Risk Assessment Engine
normalization_method: Piecewise linear interpolation between empirical percentile anchors derived from the 35-stock FinSight AI training universe. Anchors: 5th/25th/50th/75th/95th percentiles map to scores 5/25/50/75/95. Values outside anchor range are linearly extrapolated and clamped to [0,100].

metric_definitions.annualized_volatility: std(daily_returns) * sqrt(252) over last 252 trading days
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: max((close - rolling_peak) / rolling_peak) over last 252 trading days
metric_definitions.downside_volatility: std(negative daily returns only) * sqrt(252) over last 252 trading days
metric_definitions.recent_volatility: std(daily_returns) * sqrt(252) over most recent 20 trading days

reference_universe: 35 stocks (15 US + 20 Indian NSE), ~2018-2026 daily OHLCV data
disclaimer: Risk scores are statistical estimates only. Not financial advice.
